items.title: Edgar Mosley Interview, 1958-09-03
items.q: But before they used to play straight, they used to play just like Big Landry.

ctx.x: They played straight and things. But during the time when Chris Kelly and all of them got together and all, stopped playing, well, that's when the fancy trumpet come in. Yeah. You know, making all the different things. Yeah. But before they used to play straight, they used to play just like Big Landry. Oh, yes. Landry would die. And he never did change his way. He said that same way when what they played way back.
You used to hear him down in Lutzen's with Big Eye.
